video.scope: Real hosted testnet register/send/scan/spend/auditor for veil-film-recv.testnet with a scripted Node signer (not browser wallet approvals); opener uses NearBlocks API data for ref-finance.near; implicit-account card uses live RPC data

limitations: Amounts, timing, sender identity, and token contracts remain public.
Sweeping multiple stealth accounts to one destination creates a link.
The current implementation is testnet-only and uses Ed25519 implicit accounts.
Concurrent sends can store an announcement up to 32 positions after the index the sender derived with; the scanner checks that window, and larger gaps need a wider rescan.
Re-deriving keys requires the same wallet signing key. Keys from the earlier (v1) key message open via Earlier inbox.
Seven dependency alerts remain documented in docs/DEPENDABOT.md.

The deployed router has three disclosed issues (FT forward refund, storage spam on send_near, announcements lost if router storage runs out); fixes are described in docs/THREAT_MODEL.md and not deployed.
